name: Snow Globe
desc: A just-shaken snow globe — flakes swirl in a slow vortex inside a round glass vignette, settling and being re-lofted, over a soft luminous water-fill with a glass highlight; a self-contained circular flurry to sit over any centred scene.

style.doc: snow=white flakes in blue water / glitter_gold=warm gold flecks / confetti=multicolour / ink=monochrome sumi flecks
